caption: The drawing features a central rectangular frame with an empty inner space, bordered by a thick yellow-gold colored inner edge and a larger, light gray and brown outer edge. The corners of the frame have white floral designs set in square blocks. Extending from the frame are various decorative elements: at the top is a domed, canopy-like structure in shades of olive green, brown, and beige, topped with a cream-colored, flower-like ornament. Both sides of the frame display light gray, scalloped and wing-like appendages, with green and brown sections visible behind them. Below the frame, two green and brown leaf-shaped elements emerge, and at the very bottom center is a brown, spiky, rounded floral shape. Additionally, in the lower half of the drawing, there is a gray pipe with a white bowl extending from the left side and curving into the composition, resting atop a circular gray base. The rest of the background is a plain, solid beige color.
title: Candle Sconce with Mirror
